top_findings.title: Not an MCP server — plain net/http REST API
top_findings.evidence: main.go:1285-1292 registers REST routes via http.HandleFunc; grep -iE 'mcp|json-?rpc|stdio|RegisterTool|tools/call|initialize' main.go matches only the 'soccer-mcp' module name and one unrelated comment; go.mod has no MCP SDK; _agent_stdout.log states 'no MCP dependency'.
top_findings.suggestion: Expose the query functions as MCP tools over an MCP server SDK (stdio/JSON-RPC) instead of, or in addition to, REST.

top_findings.title: FIFA player CSV never loads — 0 players at runtime
top_findings.evidence: loadPlayers guard 'if len(record) < 100 { continue }' at main.go:493, but every fifa_data.csv row has <=90 fields (header 89, max data row 90), so all 18,207 rows are skipped. Match CSVs do load, so R2 is partial.
top_findings.suggestion: Change the guard to the actual FIFA column count (e.g. len(record) < 89) and align column indices to the header.

top_findings.title: Player search-by-name non-functional on real data
top_findings.evidence: GetPlayerByName (main.go:826) is correct and unit-tested, but the test injects synthetic players (main_test.go:512) and never calls LoadData; at runtime s.players is empty (R2), so /api/players?name= returns [].
top_findings.suggestion: Fix loadPlayers (R2) so search operates on the loaded FIFA dataset; add a test that loads the real CSV.

top_findings.title: Player nationality/club filtering non-functional + Brazilian-only
top_findings.evidence: GetPlayersByClub (main.go:845) and GetBrazilianPlayers (main.go:883) return [] at runtime because s.players is empty (R2). playersHandler (main.go:1177) exposes only a 'brazilian' param; no generic nationality filter.
top_findings.suggestion: Add a generic ?nationality= param backed by a GetPlayersByNationality function, and fix R2.
